verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party webhooks docs say Stripe pushes real-time data to your endpoint when account events happen. The Billing subscriptions docs say webhook events can monitor and handle subscription status transitions, and a Stripe Billing PM points merchants to their own webhooks. missing for 10: explicit evidence of endpoint registration and event-type selection, delivery retry and signature-verification details, and independent hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events happen in your Stripe account.
You can use webhook events to monitor and handle transitions between statuses.
